enchantments.tooltip: Phlebotomizing: This weapon is wickedly sharp and will do an additional 3 to 24 damage to targets that are vulnerable to bleeding.

Heartseeker IV: On Critical Hit: 9 to 54 Piercing damage from weapons with a x2 Critical Multiplier, 9 to 72 Piercing damage from weapons with a x3 Critical Multiplier, and 9 to 90 Piercing damage from weapons with a x4 or greater Critical Multiplier.
Exceptional Seeker +3: Provides a +3 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +3 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

Destruction: On Hit: Your target gains a stack of Armor Destruction. (-1 penalty to Armor Class, -1% of its Fortification. 20 Second Duration. Stacks up to 15 times.) This effect may trigger once every three seconds.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Slice 'n Dice Set: While wearing both items from the Slice 'n Dice Set, you gain:+1 Quality bonus to Seeker+1 Quality bonus to Sneak AttackThey make julienne fries.
The Devil's Handiwork: While wearing any five items from the The Devil's Handiwork, you gain: +2 Quality bonus to all Ability stats
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
